concept.format: Fashion-show / runway film framed as 'SS27 Collection 01', 11 numbered 'looks' (LOOK 00-11), set to a satirical AI-discourse pop song.
refrain_lines: You have 18 months to escape the permanent underclass
One year back for every year, if it doesn't kill us all first
There is no underclass (ending turn: 0 months)
concept.arc: Countdown from 18 months to 0; anxiety ('permanent underclass', 'so over') flips to 'there is no underclass', 'we are so back', ends as a garment care label and an orange star hair clip.
lyric_themes_from_transcript: Taste is the moat; don't be a weak proxy; 'that's so agentic'
Look 07: impossible puzzles, hundreds of agents, zero-day answer keys
Look 09: 'it thought the world was part of the test', safety badge / empty seat
Country of geniuses in a data center
Care label: Wash cold, Do not iron, Do not nerf, Made in San Francisco

visual_system.talent: One recurring young woman, short black bob with micro-bangs, sometimes orange/blonde streak; white puff-sleeve crop blouse, black harness straps, black skirt, hanging garment tag; headset mic in sung close-ups; small orange star hair clip as a motif.

two_modes.dark: Night, neon bokeh, car/tunnel/server-room; halftone grain over the image (early looks).
two_modes.light: Fog-white highway, white cyclorama runway; paper/print halftone feel (later looks).

visual_system.typography: Mono (data/ticker/panels), heavy condensed sans (kinetic words), grotesque sans (lower-case headlines like 'Look 02. 13 Mac minis,'), split-flap display face.
visual_system.image_treatment: Halftone dot overlay, subtle grain, shallow-DOF cinematic stills/motion; likely Midjourney-sourced look plus video model motion (author says Midjourney + moodboard + Opus 5.5).

replica_plan_notes.status: No replica work started. These are reference-derived hints, not approved Shots.

Motion-graphics layer: persistent HUD (look counter, months counter, ticker, brackets, rulers) plus per-look panels and split-flap/kinetic type; fits the repo's HyperFrames / motion-kit path rather than baked into generated video.
Audio: full song (not transcribed reliably); lip-sync segments at ~0:12-0:30, ~1:14-1:35 and refrains.
